title: Cross-Corridor Infrastructure Conversion Evidence, 2024-2026
summary: Eighteen reviewed official records tracing how compute and grid growth in Northern Virginia, lithium projects in Nevada, and launch infrastructure on Florida's Space Coast move from planning and authorization toward finance, construction, acceptance, operation, and measured outcomes.
scope: Phase 55V creates six-record primary-document shelves for each of three local systems. Northern Virginia connects regional load concentration to transmission planning, rate design, a named grid project, environmental permits, and reclaimed water. Nevada connects two mine and processing projects to federal land decisions, state environmental permits, federal credit, and the still-open delivery stack. Florida connects Kennedy's long-range plan to site licensing, a named environmental decision, the Part 450 framework, state capital programming, and a development-authority portfolio.
download_note: The 21-file archive contains four captured official PDFs, 14 official-link records, consolidated FTFN summaries, a README, and a SHA-256 manifest. The manifest preserves provenance, file size, and capture status for every record.
method_note: The collection compares evidence stages, not equivalent technologies or markets. A plan is not an appropriation; a permit or site license is not construction or operation; a financial decision is not financial close unless the record says so; financial close is not commissioned capacity; and an analyzed or projected activity level is not measured output, utilization, safety, or local benefit.
